script:
--// SETTINGS \\--

getgenv().Night = false -- false = night mode, true = normal

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/Ke6M8CML"))()

-- APPLY AFTER LOAD
task.wait(1)

-- sync with script
if getgenv().Night ~= nil then
    _G.NightModeEnabled = getgenv().Night

    if _G.NightModeEnabled then
        if _G.applyNightMode then
            _G.applyNightMode()
        end
    else
        -- disable night
        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        pcall(function()
            Lighting.ClockTime = 14
            Lighting.Brightness = 2
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178,178,178)
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(178,178,178)
            Lighting.FogStart = 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = 1000
            Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)

            for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if v.Name == "StarringOneCC" or v.Name == "StarringOneBloom" then
                    v:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end
